BiblicalUsage: Yâthêd is a peg, a pin driven into the ground to hold something fast. Israel was to carry a paddle on his weapon to dig with, and the pins of the tabernacle and the court were of brass.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God fastens His house with pins, and the smallest peg holds the tabernacle.
